text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx rate from eu-west inference pool (p50 latency normal). Trigger: error-rate > 5% across backbone for 3m. https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/ALRT-9843 :rotating_light:
Samir: taking this. paging SREs and infra. I'm the current oncall.
Carol: on it, looking at aggregator logs. any customer-reported errors?
Maria: support sees a spike in error reports from two EU customers. CS ticket IDs: #3421, #3423.
Samir: ok, first triage: confirm scope -> is it all models or specific serving runtime?
Carol: quick grep shows KCACHE evictions spiking on eu-west-2 nodes. stack traces include OOM-ish kv-cache failures but mem looks ok.
Leo: seeing a sudden traffic bump from eu-west-lb-3 -> +40% over baseline, probably causing cache churn.
Anya: are we sure it's real traffic and not health-check loop? ops-bot: autodeploy-check reports no recent deploys.
Samir: good. mitigation plan: 1) suppress noisy downstream alerts to avoid paging storms 2) raise cache reclaim threshold 3) shift low-priority traffic to us-west for 10m via routing override 4) update customers and create incident channel.
Carol: suppressing alerts: will mute ALRT-9843 and related node flaps for 15m. Setting mute reason: 'mitigating cache churn, will adjust thresholds after root cause'.
Samir: Leo, can you push a routing override? we want only 20% of traffic shifted, prefer gradual.
Leo: applying traffic-weight patch to routing policy now: `route: eu-west primary, fallback us-west weight=0.2` -> patch applied. Watching.
ops-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: policy update committed by Leo.
Anya: while traffic shifts, I'll bump kv-cache size parameter on the runtime in eu-west from 8GB -> 10GB (non-disruptive), patching config via canary.
Carol: logs show error-rate dropping from 6.8% -> 3.1% after shift and cache bump. latency stable. Looks promising.
Samir: great. Maria, please notify impacted customers with ETA ~30m and note we routed some traffic to us-west.
Maria: message sent to CS queue and customers notified.
Samir: handoff note for next oncall: I'll stay for 10m then handoff to Carol. Leaving instructions: monitor ALRT-9843, regional health dashboard panel (https://console.redwood.ai/d/region-health?panel=eu-west), and routing policy status.
Carol: acknowledged. I'll continue watch and create post-incident tasks: alert tuning to reduce noise when traffic spikes but cache healthy, add a failover alert that triggers only when error-rate AND cross-region latency both exceed thresholds.
Samir: action items: (A) update alert to require sustained error-rate >5% and 95th latency >300ms before paging (owner: Carol) (B) add dashboard panel showing cache eviction rate vs traffic ratio (owner: Anya) (C) add runbook step to perform traffic-weighted failover at 10/20/50% buckets (owner: Leo).
Carol: creating JIRA INC-6423 with subtasks. Also will add a temporary lower-severity metric: kv-cache-evictions > X for 3m to surface in dashboards but not page.
Anya: will add the dashboard panel and a Grafana alert with note 'do not page'.
Samir: ops-bot, annotate incident with actions and set severity -> Sev2 -> update timeline.
ops-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: Severity set to Sev2 by Samir; annotation added.
Carol: putting a tentative postmortem on calendar for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
Samir: last check: error-rate at 1.2%, traffic normalized to baseline; keeping routing override for 5 more minutes then revert.
Leo: reverting route to normal now. ops-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: policy reverted by Leo.
Samir: muting removed for ALRT-9843.
Maria: notified customers that service is restored, will follow up in 24h.
Samir: handing off to Carol. Logging final note with timeline and action items. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Carol: taking over monitoring. I'll collate logs and draft post-incident analysis.
